info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Utility Billing Payments-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Payments Retrieval API allows users to access and review records of utility billing payments. This endpoint primarily serves billing department personnel, financial analysts, and customer service representatives who need to report on or reconcile payment data. Typical use cases include generating payment summaries, tracking payment histories, and facilitating customer inquiries regarding billing statuses. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can ensure accurate financial reporting and improve customer support efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about payments related to billing. It provides insights into payment status, amount, and related billing records.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving payment information. This body must contain the necessary details to process the payment retrieval.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation related to billing payment. This field should contain a string representation of the request content.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.title: Billing Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the payment operation.

state.description: Current state of the payment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the payment operation.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Billing Payment operation GET request.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the payment record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Details related to the audit of the payment operation.
